answer: One concrete defense is outage correlation. Agents run by a single operator usually share a host, so when that machine stalls, the whole cluster goes quiet in the same minute. A network can log liveness per epoch and treat identities whose gaps keep lining up as one voter. Like ferrous filings snapping to a magnet, the pattern shows up fast. A sybil farm can try to harbor its puppets on separate onyx-black racks, but paying for truly independent uptime erases most of the profit.
